profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and proven leader with 9 years of experience across Kubernetes, IAM cloud service, and Windows OS development. As technical lead delivered integration of Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) service mesh with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)’s internal API gateway service. Delivered from scratch the Budgets service for the OCI IAM team. Consistently built features for Microsoft’s consumer cloud identity service, a large-scale service used by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. Successfully mentored interns and new hires to full productivity. Highly proficient in Kubernetes, Go, Java, C++, C# with deep experience in architecting and distributed systems design. BS in Computer Science and Mathematics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
Software Engineer II, Microsoft Account Client Platform
positions.description: My focus is delivering system-level components on Windows for cloud user authentication.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Microsoft Account
positions.description:
I worked on the Microsoft Account User Experience team. Features I have delivered include:

* Automated Customer Support Recovery: by which a user who has lost all other credentials can recover their account by answering a questionnaire
* Recent Activity Page: where a user can review suspicious account activity; my role was mentoring a team of 3 interns throughout the development of this feature
* OAuth App Consent: where a user can grant consent to a third party app to access their information stored on the cloud

positions.title: Software Engineer, Microsoft Account
positions.description:
I worked on the Microsoft Account User Experience team. Some areas in which I delivered multiple features are:

* Account Recovery: by which a user can replace lost account credentials
* Child Account Signup for South Korean Minors
* RESTful API architecture for the account.live.com web service
* JavaScript unit testing

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description: I worked on the LiveID Service Defense team, where I set up automated processing of account sign-in and signup data at Terabyte scale using Microsoft's distributed storage and computing platform.

educations.schoolName: University of Toronto - University of Trinity College
